verdict.rationale: Docs confirm best-in-class PBR materials, WebGPU/WebGL rendering, a node material editor, and clustered lighting, which are core pieces of a modern renderer, and community posts (comm-2, comm-5, comm-9) attest to strong visual/documentation quality in practice. However, the evidence pack never explicitly documents shadow mapping, a post-processing pipeline, or global illumination/baked lighting workflows, leaving key parts of the story unverified. Missing for 10: explicit shadow system documentation, post-processing pipeline documentation, GI/baked-lighting documentation, independent hands-on confirmation of these specific renderer features.
